expected_behavior: When the request names a topic but no claim, the skill asks once, in one open panel, what the article must convince the reader of before writing.
The loop always runs o-analyze, then o-roast, then o-humanize, in that order, and repeats until the roast scores strong and the text reads clean.
The humanized text never goes out before the roast has scored it.
A final facts-only check confirms that numbers, names, URLs and corrected claims survived the rewrite unchanged.
